The following events took place in '''35 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] were rediscovered.
*The [[Dark Nest Crisis]] occurred.
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] saw an image of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|his mother]] for the first time.<ref name="Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
*[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] published ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.
*The [[New Jedi Temple]] was constructed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], after the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Old Jedi Temple]] were demolished.
